channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: IAEA accuses Iran of ‘non-compliance’: Why, and what now?
item.description: Nuclear watchdog has gone more than a year without inspecting key sites; Iran says US attacks have made access unsafe.

item.title: Qatar beat Iran in men’s basketball as Asian Games begin in Japan
item.description: The continental games will officially open on September 19, but several team competitions will get under way earlier.

item.title: Houthis, Yemeni forces engaged in fierce battles: Why each front matters
item.description: Forces loyal to the UN-recognised government and Houthis fight on multiple fronts in an effort to expand their control.

item.title: Russian attacks kill 7 in Ukraine as Kyiv targets gas plants deep in Arctic
item.description: Ukraine launches one of its deepest strikes to date, targeting natural gas plants in Russia's Arctic region.

item.title: Fighting escalates in Yemen; Houthi attacks trigger alerts in Saudi Arabia
item.description: Yemen's government accuses Houthis of killing three children as rebels claim Saudi forces launched 54 air raids in 12 hours.

item.title: Ukrainian drones strike Russian Caspian Sea port in Dagestan
item.description: Fires and explosions were seen in Russia’s Dagestan after a Ukrainian drone attack.

item.title: Why is Iran bombing Jordan’s Al-Azraq base?
item.description: Iran has increased its targeting of Jordan’s Muwaffaq Salti Air Base near Al-Azraq in recent weeks.

item.title: Iran war won't end until after crucial November elections, says Trump
item.description: The president also said oil prices won't come down until after the November races, claiming without evidence that Iran wants to impact the election.

item.title: Muted US response to UK's West Bank sanctions may reflect simmering frustration
item.description: The UK accuses Israel's government of turning a blind eye to the "ethnic cleansing" of Palestinians by settlers.

item.title: Watch: How a community living under demolition orders from Israel view UK sanctions
item.description: Middle East Correspondent Lucy Williamson visits the Palestinian community of Khan al Ahmar, and the neighbouring Israeli settlement of Maale Admumim.
